consequence.statement: GlobalContextEntry resources that use apiCall will now automatically retry failed API calls up to 3 times by default; existing resources without explicit retryLimit will gain this behavior.

assertion.statement: Kyverno's GlobalContextEntry API adds an optional `retryLimit` field to the `spec.apiCall` object, which defaults to 3 and specifies the number of times Kyverno will retry failed API calls.
